Phone MCP turns this phone into a server that AI assistants (MCP clients) can connect to. The app has no AI built in — you connect your own, for example Claude Desktop.

1. Enable the tools you want to expose.
2. Start the server with the toggle.
3. On a computer on the same Wi-Fi network, copy the client configuration into your MCP client.

Use the Test connection button any time to verify the server is reachable.
Invalid port number. Please enter a value between 1 and 65535.
